for alarm in alarms:
    if alarm["label"] != "Wake Up" or not alarm["enabled"]:
        continue
    # Skip the go-to-sleep alarm
    if alarm["alarm_id"] == go_to_sleep_alarm["alarm_id"]:
        continue
    # Disable the alarm
    disable_result = apis.phone.update_alarm(
        access_token=access_token,
        alarm_id=alarm["alarm_id"],
        enabled=False
    )
    print(disable_result)
